steps.note: Both build commands succeeded; build/Tessera.app was created.
The window opened with 5 images, but the sample.dng thumbnail was blank. The status bar showed no error.
The first image showed a REJECT badge after X.
Auto-advance had already selected the second image, so → then P marked the third instead. I cleared that unintended decision and marked the second KEEP.
After relaunch, the first REJECT and second KEEP badges persisted. ls showed fuji-raf.RAF.xmp and nikon-nef.NEF.xmp beside the raws.
⌘Q closed Tessera; a computer_use screenshot confirmed its window was gone.
